The caterpillar reaches weight 10 after **9217 days**.

Each leg goes from the current fruit to the next fruit on the opposite side, so the distances are 1, 2, 3, …, and the caterpillar's weight when starting leg $k$ is $k-1$. Each leg therefore takes (distance) × $2^{w}$ days.

| Leg | Route | Distance | Weight during leg | Time (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | $0 \to 1$ | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 2 | $1 \to -1$ | 2 | 1 | 4 |
| 3 | $-1 \to 2$ | 3 | 2 | 12 |
| 4 | $2 \to -2$ | 4 | 3 | 32 |
| 5 | $-2 \to 3$ | 5 | 4 | 80 |
| 6 | $3 \to -3$ | 6 | 5 | 192 |
| 7 | $-3 \to 4$ | 7 | 6 | 448 |
| 8 | $4 \to -4$ | 8 | 7 | 1024 |
| 9 | $-4 \to 5$ | 9 | 8 | 2304 |
| 10 | $5 \to -5$ | 10 | 9 | 5120 |

After leg 10 the caterpillar eats the fruit at $-5$ and has weight 10. The total is

$$1+4+12+32+80+192+448+1024+2304+5120 = 9217.$$

ANSWER: 9217
